items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: For one thing it was Thad, and Hank, and Frank West and Frank Foster. All these guys came, you know, Eddie Jones and everybody came over there to help me out.

ctx.x: Mhmm. That’s the cover. And do you recall any highlights, any of the session?

Well, quite a few. For one thing it was Thad, and Hank, and Frank West and Frank Foster. All these guys came, you know, Eddie Jones and everybody came over there to help me out. I had a lot of expert help on that. I had never saw that before, I was pretty ignorant at that time. They walked me through that maze.
And were you happy with the results of that session?
